title: satureja obovata
intro: Satureja obovata, commonly known as Rock savory, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, known for its fragrant leaves and stems. The health benefits of Rock savory include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which may help to combat infections and reduce oxidative stress in the body. The therapeutic actions of Satureja obovata include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which may aid in relieving pain and reducing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
